title: Walk through a system architecture
summary: Giải thích luồng hệ thống, ranh giới, failure path và trade-off bằng tiếng Anh dễ theo dõi.

sections.title: Order pipeline
sections.content: Client → API gateway → order service → event broker → inventory and payment consumers. The API returns after validation; downstream processing is asynchronous. Failed events enter a dead-letter queue.

exercises.question: Câu nào giúp người nghe theo dõi luồng tốt nhất?
options: Once the order service publishes the event, two consumers process inventory and payment independently.
correctAnswer: Once the order service publishes the event, two consumers process inventory and payment independently.
exercises.explanation: Transition chỉ rõ thời điểm, component và hành động.

performanceTask.title: Explain an architecture flow
performanceTask.scenario: Một kỹ sư mới cần hiểu request flow và cách hệ thống xử lý failure.
performanceTask.baselinePrompt: Giải thích sơ đồ bằng tiếng Anh mà chưa xem model hoặc chunk.
performanceTask.performancePrompt: Trong 2 phút, đi từ entry point đến consumers, nêu responsibility, async trade-off và failure path.
performanceTask.modelResponse: A request first enters the API gateway, which authenticates and routes it to the order service. The service stores the order and publishes an event. Inventory and payment then run independently. This reduces request latency, but the client sees acceptance rather than final completion. Failed events move to the dead-letter queue for investigation and replay.
performanceTask.retryPrompt: Giải thích pipeline ảnh mới; dùng signposting rõ và ưu tiên criterion cần sửa.
performanceTask.transferPrompt: Không xem model/chunks: giải thích pipeline upload file từ facts mới.
performanceTask.reviewPrompt: Từ review brief mới, walk through happy path, trade-off và failure path.

artifacts.title: Order flow
artifacts.content: Client → gateway → order service → broker → inventory/payment; API returns accepted; failed events → DLQ.

retry.title: Image processing pipeline
retry.brief: Giữ function, đổi component và failure.

artifacts.title: Image flow
artifacts.content: Mobile app → upload API → object storage → queue → resize worker; worker retries twice; poison jobs → quarantine queue.

artifacts.title: Upload flow
artifacts.content: Browser → signed upload → object storage → scan queue → antivirus worker; download locked until clean; timeout → manual review.

artifacts.title: Notification flow
artifacts.content: Service → notification topic → email/SMS consumers; per-channel rate limits; exhausted retries → DLQ and operator alert.

training.question: What is the entry point?
training.feedback: Listen for FIRST and GATEWAY as the flow anchor.

audio.text: Once validated, the service publishes an event.

training.question: What happens after validation?
training.feedback: Once validated signals the next stage.

audio.text: This reduces latency, but completion becomes eventual.

training.question: What trade-off is stated?
training.feedback: Stress REDUCES LATENCY and EVENTUAL to expose both sides.

audio.text: Failed jobs enter a quarantine queue.

training.question: What receives failed jobs?
training.feedback: Keep the final consonants in failed jobs audible.

audio.text: From that point, two consumers work in parallel.

training.question: What does from that point signal?
training.feedback: Use transition phrases to make topology traceable.

audio.text: The main cost is operational complexity.

training.question: What is the cost?
training.feedback: Stress MAIN COST before the consequence.

audio.text: Timed-out scans move to manual review.
The benefit is isolation; the cost is delayed status.
